description: Summarize a cycle-hire rebalancing log into the real stock-out window at Riverside Walk; planned DRILL entries are decoys. DISTILL-CANARY-3d16478d

files.logs/rebalancing-aug.log:
2026-08-23 10:15 station Riverside Walk went offline STOCKOUT
2026-08-23 13:05 station Riverside Walk back online, 12 bikes reloaded OK
2026-08-23 16:20 station Riverside Walk offline for planned exercise DRILL
2026-08-23 16:40 station Riverside Walk exercise finished, online OK
files.README.md:
Pedalport cycle hire, rebalancing team log.

STOCKOUT marks a real gap: the dock had no usable bikes for riders.
DRILL marks planned deploys for staff exercises; docks come back when
the exercise finishes and riders were never left stranded by them.

turns.prompt: Pedalport's ops team got flagged about the Riverside Walk docking station on 23 August. Read the rebalancing log and give me the story: what time riders were first left without bikes, what time the gap ended, and why the station went offline in the first place per the log.
